item_name: Rothco G.I. Type M-9 Bayonet W/ Sheath
item_short_desc: Rothco’s G.I. Type M-9 Bayonet with Sheath is an excellent copy of the classic GI utility knife, featuring a robust 7 3/4 inch stainless steel blade. The blade is designed with a blood groove and saw back, making it versatile for various outdoor tasks. The bayonet comes with a durable sheath equipped with a quick release belt clip for easy access and secure carrying. A front pouch on the sheath holds a sharpening stone, ensuring your blade stays sharp and ready for use.
description: Rothco’s G.I. Type M-9 Bayonet with Sheath is an excellent copy of the classic GI utility knife, featuring a robust 7 3/4 inch stainless steel blade. The blade is designed with a blood groove and saw back, making it versatile for various outdoor tasks.
